summary: Company-plan the free-first orderflow+quant trading build (nautilus_trader v2 + IBKR paper + free data) for a Fable 5 P0-P2 execution handoff. Decompose into role->leaf work packets, design module boundaries against the EXISTING alpha-factor-library, adversarially critique the phasing + reuse-vs-rebuild + GEX-sign risk, and confirm the $0 free-first constraint holds. Planning + advisory only — DISARMED, no code mutation, no arming.

gaps: IBKR paper wiring (dockerized IB Gateway + nautilus IB adapter)

subtasks.prompt: Decode the orderflow+quant build into an explicit goal spine + a role->leaf work-packet map for P0->P2. Output: ordered packet list, each with owner-role, inputs, deliverable, verification gate.

Design module boundaries for the 5 gaps (IC spine, footprint/AMT, GEX, instrument layer, IB wiring) as clean seams onto the EXISTING alpha-factor-library. Specify: which existing modules each new module imports (ofi.mjs, orderbook-imbalance.mjs, factor-evaluator.mjs deflatedSharpe/BH-FDR, trade-edge-audit.mjs, trade-decision-sim.mjs CVaR, afl-paper.mjs, observatory/, ensemble.mjs), the nautilus OrderBookDelta/OrderBookDepth10 adapter boundary, and the integration contract (data shapes crossing each seam). DISARMED-first for every new module.

Local-first confirm the reuse surfaces: for each alpha-factor-library module named above, confirm it exists, is crypto-only, and name the exact extension seam to equities/futures/options. CRITICAL: verify whether factor-evaluator.mjs already computes IC (information coefficient) or only deflated-Sharpe/BH-FDR — the research doc claims IC is 'currently absent'; prove or refute that against the actual code.

Refute-by-default critique of the plan: (1) is the P0->P2 phasing right or does something in P1/P2 actually block P0? (2) reuse-vs-rebuild — is any 'reuse' target too crypto-coupled to extend cleanly? (3) the naive GEX dealer-sign (+call/-put) approximation risk — how wrong can it be, what validates it? (4) nautilus v2 RC maturity risk on the OrderBook API surface. Name the strongest failure mode of the whole build.

Confirm the free-first $0 constraint holds across P0->P2. Enumerate every data/infra dependency and its true cost. Flag ANY hidden paid dependency (data sub, cloud, API metering) that would breach $0 before an edge is proven. Confirm the Databento $125 credit is a one-time wedge, not a recurring commitment.

Honesty audit on the research doc's 5 UNCONFIRMED flags (Polygon L2, dxFeed macOS MBO, CME DataMine rate card, SpotGamma institutional API, Tier1Alpha API). Which of these actually matter for P0->P2, and which are P3+ noise? Mark each: BLOCKING / DEFERRED / IRRELEVANT for the free-first build.

Write the MURE company-plan doc: the role->leaf map, module-boundary design, adversarial verdicts, cost confirmation, and calibration table — as a single Fable-facing reference. Output path suggestion: 02_RESOURCES/RESEARCH/orderflow-quant-fable-prep-2026-07-06/lanes/mure-company-plan.md
